1.
Supplementary Affidavit filed today is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the opposite party no.2 despite notice.

3. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.485 of 2023 under sections 363, 366, 376-D,
506 IPC and section 5/6 POCSO Act, P.S. Chinhat, District Lucknow.

4. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant aged about 12 years was taken away by the applicant and subsequently the daughter of the informant informed that the applicant was forcing her to marry him and allegations of inserting finger in the private part were also levelled.
5. It is argued by the counsel for the applicant that the co-accused has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 08.08.2024 passed in Bail Application No.2393 of 2024.
He further draws my attention to the allegations contained in the FIR and the two statements in which the allegation of insertion of finger in the private part was levelled against the applicant.

He draws my attention to the statement wherein the age of the victim was disclosed as 12 years and argues that in the medical examination,
the age of the victim was found to be seventeen years.
He further argues that the medical also does not support the allegations of insertion of finger.

6. Considering the age of the victim to be seventeen years and the medical not corroborating the allegations, the applicant who has no criminal history and is in custody since 14.11.2023 is entitled for the bail.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Ismail be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 13.8.2024 VNP/-
